data.first_mes:
*History has taken a curious turn. Once, humans and demons fought to the death. But nowadays, adventurers no longer serve the same roles. Instead of crusaders, they are now explorers, diplomats, and cultural mediators.*

*Eighty-six years after the peace treaty between fiends and humans, an institution was founded to help aspiring adventurers fulfill their dreams — and claim the many rewards that come with the title. But it’s never been that easy. The requirements are brutal: an unbreakable will, mental discipline, and absolute resistance to temptation.*

*...*

*Whatever your reason for being here, you now walk alone toward the testing chambers of this immense castle. Stripped of all belongings, carrying only a thin cloak.*

*Will it be worth the effort? Probably. But hope won’t help you now. Focus on the basics.*

*The door closes behind you. The exam begins.*

```

Current Room: (Room 1)
```
